The epitope of Fab KZ52 on the Zaire Ebola glycoprotein (GP) was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. Purified EBOV GP1,2 ectodomains (lacking the mucin domain [residues 312 to 462]) were treated with thermolysin, which mimics host endosomal protease processing of EBOV GP, in order to generate EBOV GP(CL) trimers for crystallization. EBOV GP(CL) crystallizes with four GP monomers and four KZ52 Fabs in the asymmetric unit. The ASU contains one full GP trimer and one remaining GP monomer, which itself forms a biologically relevant trimer with two symmetry-related protomers about a crystallographic 3-fold axis.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.3 angstroms
The epitope-specific antibody KZ52 was used in an ELISA assay to detect Ebola glycoprotein (GP).

The epitope of Fab 3T0265 on EBOV GP was determined from the structure of the complex resolved to a resolution of 2.99 Å by single-particle cryo-electron microscopy analysis. The trimeric EBOV GP lacked the mucin-like and transmebrane domains.
The epitope of 3T0331 Fab on EBOV GP was determined from the structure of the complex resolved to a resolution of 3.1 Å by single-particle cryo-electron microscopy.
The epitope of 4m0368 Fab on EBOV GP was determined from the structure of the complex resolved to a resolution of 3.3 Å by single-particle cryo-electron microscopy.

The epitope on EBOV GP was determined from the structure of the complex resolved to a resolution of 2.91 Å by single-particle cryo-electron microscopy analysis. The trimeric EBOV GP lacked the mucin-like and transmebrane domains.

The epitope of the epitope specific mAb on the EBOV GP ΔMLD trimer was determined by single particle reconstruction cryo-electron microscopy of the quaternary complex of mAbs REGN3479, REGN3470, and REGN3471 on the EBOV GP trimer at a resolution of 3.1 Å.  The structure showed that some classes had nine Fab fragments bound (i.e. three copies of each of the three different mAbs), and others having eight Fab fragments bound (two copies of REGN3470, plus three each of REGN3471, and REGN3479).
